subject: EdgeOps Labs — billing exception for pilot onboarding (no-PO request)
messages:
From: Aisha Gupta <aisha@edgeops.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: EdgeOps Labs Procurement <procurement@edgeops.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick question on onboarding — PO timing

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the latency numbers. We want to kick off a two-week pilot next Monday, but our procurement cycle for POs is currently paused for system migration and will likely take 3-4 weeks.

Is there a way for EdgeOps to be onboarded without a PO for this short pilot? We can commit to a capped invoice and provide whatever vendor forms you need (W-9, insurance). If not, can we start with a limited credit card charge or net-30 invoice without PO?

Attaching our vendor onboarding form for reference.

Thanks,
Aisha Gupta
Head of Business Ops | EdgeOps Labs
Attachment: edgeops_onboarding_form.pdf (pdf)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Gupta <aisha@edgeops.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on onboarding — PO timing

Hi Aisha —

Appreciate the note and the onboarding form. Short answer: we can support a temporary invoice-only path for pilots under specific safeguards.

Proposed approach:
- Pilot cap: $7,500 total for the two-week pilot.
- Documentation required: completed onboarding form, W-9, COI (if services exceed $5k), and a billing contact.
- Payment terms: net-30 invoice from Redwood; procurement can issue PO retroactively once their system is back.
- Exception duration: one-time exception for up to 30 days; further usage requires a PO or Dedicated contract.

If this works for you, please return the completed onboarding packet and billing_contact_sheet.xlsx, and I will route this for approval with procurement. Looping in Karthik (Head of Procurement) to confirm.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_po_policy_summary.pdf (policy summary)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on onboarding — PO timing

On Thu, May 20, 2027 at 10:03 AM Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com> wrote:
> Proposed approach:
> - Pilot cap: $7,500 total for the two-week pilot.
> - Documentation required: completed onboarding form, W-9, COI (if services exceed $5k), and a billing contact.
> - Payment terms: net-30 invoice from Redwood; procurement can issue PO retroactively once their system is back.
> - Exception duration: one-time exception for up to 30 days; further usage requires a PO or Dedicated contract.

This looks reasonable to me with one minor tweak: require the W-9 and billing contact before provisioning and COI within 5 business days if the pilot reaches >$5k. Also add a clause that the pilot will be downgraded to read-only if outstanding invoices exceed the cap.

Marissa — please flag anything else we should require from Sales (SLA acknowledgement, SSO details) before approving. If no objections, I approve the exception on the conditions above.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Procurement | Redwood Inference

---
Monica Patel (Cc) — can you confirm the PO retroactive process and where we track these exceptions?

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Gupta <aisha@edgeops.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 14:37:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Quick question on onboarding — PO timing

Hi Aisha —

Thanks for sending the form and W-9 earlier. Karthik approved the temporary invoice-only onboarding with the conditions he noted. Next steps to finalize: 

1) Please confirm acceptance of the pilot cap ($7,500) and net-30 terms in reply to this thread.
2) Return the completed billing_contact_sheet.xlsx with the name, email and phone of the person who will receive invoices and approve payments.
3) If you expect to exceed $5k during the pilot, upload a COI within 5 business days of provisioning.

Once we have those items, I will request provisioning. Our finance team will issue the first invoice at the end of the pilot window and procurement can add the PO retroactively when their system comes online.

Looking forward to getting you started — excited to see what EdgeOps builds with the platform.

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachment: billing_contact_sheet.xlsx (spreadsheet)
